generation_cost: shared with stage2; not charged again

fit_budget_example.caveat: starting workload example, not guaranteed sufficient or elapsed runtime; code/config and adequate CV groups must be available. SVM repeated deterministic seeds need not duplicate identical fits.

compute_formula: sum_m(n_fits_m * measured_hours_per_fit_m * price_per_hour_m) + prediction/feature/audit/bootstrap compute; report CPU/GPU separately
same_target_ci: reuse frozen predictions for paired test resampling; no extra model fitting for ordinary test bootstrap
extra_fit_costs_not_in_160: outer resampling of generated training data requiring refit
unknowns: additional independent groups/episodes required by pilot
result_policy: Missing method or target is NOT_MEASURED; cheap debug models cannot stand in for the fixed four-method report.
seed_reporting_policy: Mean of frozen per-seed metrics and paired differences, with all seed results preserved; no best-seed selection or score ensemble. Main CI conditional on fixed seed models, resamples identical target indices for all seeds, then averages metrics. Training-generation uncertainty requires extra refits.
